articles.title: A 'Godzilla' Cloud on the Sun? This Backyard Video Is Real!
articles.summary: A photographer in Arizona filmed a giant plasma cloud on the sun that looks like Godzilla. The cloud is held by magnetic fields and is not fire—it's super-hot glowing gas.

articles.title: Three Planets Are Putting on a Show in the Evening Sky—Here's How to Catch It!
articles.summary: Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury are lining up in the western sky after sunset. On June 9, Venus and Jupiter will be super close—only 1.6 degrees apart. You can see all three with just your eyes.

articles.title: Millions of Hidden Treasures: Inside the Smithsonian's Secret Storage
articles.summary: The Smithsonian has nearly 150 million objects, but only a tiny fraction are on display. In a giant storage site, scientists keep everything from meteorites to a freeze-dried seal that smells like burnt soy sauce.
